adjudication.rationale: The finding is correct. Looking at addGuests.handler.ts lines 119-147, the `evt: CalendarEvent` object is constructed without a `team` property. In email-manager.ts lines 522-552, the `sendAddGuestsEmails` function checks `calendarEvent.team?.members` to send emails to team members. Since `team` is never set in the handler, this branch will never execute for team bookings, meaning other assigned hosts won't receive the guest addition notification. This is a real bug where team members are excluded from receiving update emails.
